sentences.en: In his fantasy, he imagined he was a famous writer.
sentences.zh: 在他的想象中，他觉得自己是个著名的作家。

sentences.en: Some know that science fantasy is different from science fiction.
sentences.zh: 有些人知道科幻奇幻与科幻小说是不同的。

sentences.en: Randy likes the new fantasy and sci-fi books in Tagalog.
sentences.zh: 兰迪喜欢用塔加洛语写的新的奇幻和科幻书籍。

senses.zh: 耽于幻想；奏幻想曲（等于phantasy）
